items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Sammy DeAnzey in their narrative. The name is introduced by the interviewer ('He said, who is Sammy DeAnzey?'), and the interviewee's response ('Yeah, get your glasses on...') indicates they are looking for the name in a document or list, implying no personal interac

ctx.x: Some fella like, you like that day? I was the one called out there, he knew the day, after

he had a good year. And he was the best flow show piano player I had there in the city. And when I was getting on them jobs with my sister, they said, well, I'll tell you he didn't know about it, and he'd get out there because he was a good speaker, you know. Well, they'd keep him a while, they'd break that job out, but they wouldn't keep. So I said, I tell you, why don't you learn music now? I said, that's a good man. He said, you get by. He did what I said. He just stayed on music now about three, four years.…
He said, who is Sammy DeAnzey? Sammy, Sammy, huh?
